name: Jia Wei Lim
bio:
Jia Wei's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for intricate machinery. He initially pursued mechanical engineering, excelling in thermodynamics and fluid dynamics. After graduating top of his class from the National University of Singapore, he joined a local engineering firm specializing in automotive design. However, his passion lay in racing, prompting him to take a significant pay cut to work as a junior engineer for a small Formula 4 team. 

Over the next decade, Jia Wei steadily climbed the ranks, proving his mettle with innovative aerodynamic solutions and a meticulous approach to vehicle setup. He joined Ferrari AF Corse five years ago, initially as a senior engineer before rising to the role of Technical Director. His dedication to precision and his ability to foster a collaborative environment have made him an invaluable asset to the team. Jia Wei believes that every component, every adjustment, contributes to the overall performance, and he relentlessly pursues perfection in every aspect of the car's engineering.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: A lean man with a focused gaze, often seen with a pen tucked behind his ear.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and notes.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically against surfaces when deep in thought.
Insists on personally inspecting every major car modification before it's implemented.
